postal_system.postcode_rule: Normalize exactly four Unicode-compatible digits while preserving leading zero. La Poste Tunisienne search observations are keyed by governorate, delegation and locality; syntax, a UPU example or a search hit alone does not prove a complete current registry, exclusive delivery catchment, deliverability or polygon.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Store a permitted minimized La Poste observation with the returned code, delivery office or centre or locality, query dimensions, observed_at, effective interval when known, selected fields and response digest. Live lookup may validate freshness but is never treated as unrestricted training or bulk mirror data.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No verified reusable nationwide La Poste postcode-polygon release is bundled. A La Poste office point, nearest-office calculation, locality label, governorate or delegation boundary, route, buffer, Voronoi cell, model surface, OSM feature or AGID cell is not an official postcode polygon. A rights-cleared administrative crosswalk may create only a derived review surface with method, edition, uncertainty, exclusions and digests; canonical geometry requires explicit La Poste authority for the same assignment and time.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Governorate, delegation, commune and locality identities and geometries remain separate from La Poste assignments. The March 2025 delegation resource currently says licence not specified; the March 2025 governorate resource states CC BY but is still coarse administrative context, not postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: UPU April 2014 guidance models addressee or organization, entrance, staircase, building, letter-box detail, street number and name, locality and four-digit delivery office or centre line separately. Its examples define a dated format, not current address rows, exact coordinates, delivery entitlement or public reuse rights.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a stable rights-cleared civic-address identifier plus an explicit reviewed authoritative address-to-building relation with validity and digest. Postcode or administrative containment, OTC parcel overlap, address text, nearest OSM footprint or model score supplies candidate context only and must not fabricate an exact building.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: OTC cadastral parcel, title and map-search information stays in a separate controlled domain. It is not a postcode or La Poste assignment, civic address, address-to-building relation, owner or occupant publication permission.
postal_system.realtime_and_model_rule: Realtime lookup improves currency only through timeout, rate, provenance, observed-time, cache and failure controls. Models may normalize Arabic and French names, detect drift, rank review candidates and estimate uncertainty-bearing non-canonical surfaces; they cannot create an official assignment, boundary, civic address or building relation.
postal_system.compression_rule: Rights-cleared polygons may be simplified, quantized and packaged as PMTiles only after topology, maximum-error and crosswalk tests. Source rights, edition, transformation chain, uncertainty and digests remain attached; compression never upgrades authority.
postal_system.licence_rule: Each artifact pins provider, exact resource, licence, attribution, version and digest. The national open-data framework does not override a resource marked licence not specified. Public portal or search visibility is not database extraction, mirroring or redistribution permission; OSM remains a separately attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Organic Law No. 2004-63 and the current La Poste charter govern identifiable addresses, geolocation and queries. Minimize collection, separate public geometry from persons, define purpose and retention, secure access, and obtain applicable INPDP authorization before foreign transfer; public source visibility does not remove these duties.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Precise private addresses, residents, owners, occupants, deliveries, credentials and sensitive query logs stay in approved controlled infrastructure after Tunisian legal and transfer review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The UPU sheet is dated April 2014 and administrative resources are dated March 2025. Every production assignment, geometry, address link and building relation stores source edition, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and digest; old examples or boundaries are never silently treated as current.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index and versioned crosswalk. It does not become a La Poste postcode, delivery catchment, governorate or delegation boundary, OTC parcel, civic address, exact building or delivery entitlement.
